title: Monotonicity of e^{κρ}ρ^{−n}μ_R(B_ρ(z)) under a bounded mean curvature identity (Simon Ch. 4, 3.14–3.17)
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (H : Euclid P → Euclid P) (κ : ℝ) (z : Euclid P) (r : ℝ), closedBall z r ⊆ U → AEMeasurable (fun x => (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection) R.measure → AEStronglyMeasurable H R.measure → (∀ x, ‖H x‖ ≤ κ) → (∀ X : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ 1 X → HasCompactSupport X → tsupport X ⊆ ball z r → R.firstVariation X = -∫ x, inner ℝ (X x) (H x) ∂R.measure) → ∀ σ ρ : ℝ, 0 < σ → σ ≤ ρ → ρ ≤ r → ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (κ * σ) / σ ^ n) * R.measure (ball z σ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (κ * ρ) / ρ ^ n) * R.measure (ball z ρ)
